period_note: Income-statement figures are CUMULATIVE Jan-Sep 2025 (the filing's own '01 January to 30 September 2025' column, the first of 4 P&L columns; a discrete 'July to September' pair also exists in the source and is not used). SOLO / STANDALONE basis (a Consolidated version incl. Islami Bank Securities Ltd and Islami Bank Capital Management Ltd also appears in the source and is not used). Source is a scanned/signed copy with no text layer, OCR'd via tesseract. Balance sheet ties exactly with no correction needed: liabilities 2,236,738,233,573 + equity 69,635,975,299 = assets 2,306,374,208,872 (exact match); the 5 deposit sub-lines sum to the deposits total (off by BDT 1, rounding); the 4 equity sub-lines sum exactly to equity; the operating-expense sub-lines sum to the stated total (off by BDT 1); PBT minus 'Provision for taxation for the period' (the full tax charge -- 'Deferred tax' of -111,402,467, a credit, is a memo sub-component, not additive) reproduces PAT (1,679,150,213-891,486,429=787,663,784 vs reported 787,663,783, BDT 1 rounding). The SOLO balance sheet's 'Investments' summary row dropped the 'General investments etc.' sub-line in OCR; it is filled from Note 9.1's own total (1,803,059,742,343), which reproduces the summary row exactly when added to Bills purchased & discounted (1,803,059,742,343+15,540,814,837=1,818,600,557,180). Note 11.1's per-category breakdown of 'D. Provision made during the period' again had its Off-Balance-Sheet sub-item OCR'd without its negative sign (a release, not an addition) -- recovered via closing-minus-opening per category (Unclassified +2,840,670,000; Classified +2,262,430,000; Off-BS -4,828,890,000), which sum exactly to the reported D total of 274,210,000, confirming the sign correction (the same OCR pattern seen in the 2025 Q2 file). This interim filing does not disclose the absolute Classified Investment balance -- only the provision held/movement against it -- so classified_loans and npl_pct are not available. Note 11.1's comparative column is the full prior year (FY2024). MAJOR BONUS FINDING, genuinely new versus the annual-only dataset: Note 11.1.1 shows the bank's own disclosed provision shortfall escalating within FY2025 itself -- required provision for classified investments (objective criteria) jumped from Tk 177,585.9m at Q2 2025 to Tk 786,323.45m at Q3 2025 (verified internally consistent: 8,799,870,000+10,181,370,000+786,323,450,000+87,639,040,000=892,943,730,000, the stated 'Total provision for investment'), while maintained provision was materially unchanged; the total provision shortfall across all investment categories widened from Tk 805,050.55m (Q2) to Tk 821,859.03m (Q3). The filing states Bangladesh Bank required a time-bound action plan to overcome the provision and capital shortfall, and that by Q3 2025 this plan had been approved by the Board and submitted to Bangladesh Bank (Q2's filing had said only that it 'will submit').
